hunger.description: Decays agent energy each tick, increases hunger

movement.description: Agents move toward goals or wander randomly

resource_spawn.description: Spawns food and material on the grid

collect.description: Agents auto-collect resources from their cell

combat.description: Resolves fights between aggressive co-located agents

trade.description: Bilateral resource exchange between cooperative agents

reproduction.description: Agents reproduce when energy exceeds threshold

mutation.description: Random trait mutations for genetic drift

death.description: Removes agents with zero energy/health or past max age
